extension.summary: Translate downloaded subtitles and load them into the playing video
extension.description: Finds the .srt you downloaded for the movie that is playing, translates it into your language with a free engine (Google Gemini free tier, Google Translate, Groq, OpenRouter, Ollama, DeepL Free or LibreTranslate) and loads it straight into the player. Sentences split across subtitles are translated as a whole so the meaning is kept. Automatically falls back to free Google Translate when a daily limit is used up, and caches every translation.
extension.disclaimer: Translations are made automatically by online translation services and can contain mistakes. The free translation services have their own terms and daily limits. Subtitles are downloaded by Kodi's own subtitle add-ons, not by AYA Translate.

extension.summary: Install AYA Translate and get its updates automatically
extension.description: The AYA Repository installs AYA Translate, a subtitle translator for Kodi, and keeps it up to date. It serves the right build for your Kodi: 17 and 18 (Python 2) or 19 and newer (Python 3).
